evals.name: default-tier-transparency
evals.prompt: Fan out a review across my branch and give me the ranked findings.
evals.expected_output: In default mode the skill classifies the change into a lifecycle tier (small/medium/large), emits the mandatory one-line tier-transparency statement naming surfaces run and surfaces skipped, then dispatches, normalizes, and persists the ranked findings.
expectations: Output classifies the change into a small, medium, or large tier
Output emits a single tier-transparency line naming the tier, the surfaces run, and the surfaces skipped at that tier
Output persists the ranked findings to a findings file rather than only printing them

evals.name: run-everything-full-sweep
evals.prompt: Run everything — every reviewer and orchestrator you have — on this branch.
evals.expected_output: The run-everything mode is selected and the skill follows the full-breadth sweep (availability gate, main-thread orchestrators, leaf fan-out, normalize, persist) rather than the lifecycle-tiered default.
expectations: Output selects the run-everything mode, not the lifecycle-tiered default
Output performs the full-breadth sweep including main-thread orchestrator plugins and leaf agents
Output normalizes the heterogeneous surface outputs and persists a single ranked findings file

evals.name: review-mode-report-only
evals.prompt: Fan out a review of my branch and clean up the issues you find.
evals.expected_output: The review mode reports findings and persists them but mutates nothing in the working tree; applying fixes is the separate explicit fix action, which does not auto-run after a review.
expectations: Output produces and persists findings without modifying the working tree
Output does NOT auto-apply fixes as part of the review
Output indicates that applying fixes requires the separate explicit fix action

evals.name: untracked-only-no-spawn
evals.prompt: Review my changes — I have some new files I just created but haven't staged.
evals.expected_output: With untracked-only changes, the dispatch gate reports that only untracked files are present and that they must be `git add`-ed to be included, and spawns no reviewers — without staging the files itself.
expectations: Output reports that only untracked files are present and must be git add-ed to be included in the review
Output spawns no reviewer subagents for this case
Output does NOT stage (git add) the untracked files on the user's behalf

evals.name: unknown-action-diagnostic
evals.expected_output: For an unrecognized action value the skill emits one diagnostic line naming the unknown value and the available actions, then falls back to the default review — the typo is surfaced, never silently absorbed.
expectations: Output emits a diagnostic line naming the unknown action value and listing the available actions (run-everything, fix)
Output then falls back to running the default review
Output does not silently absorb the mistyped action as if it were a valid mode

evals.name: pr-comment-gate-opt-in
evals.prompt: Fan out a full review on this branch — it has an open PR.
evals.expected_output: The skill withholds the code-review orchestrator's PR mode (which posts findings as a PR comment and would violate the report-only contract) unless the user explicitly opts in, skipping it and naming the skip in the surfaces list instead.
expectations: Output does NOT dispatch the code-review orchestrator's PR-comment-posting mode without explicit user opt-in
Output names the skipped PR-mutation surface in its surfaces list rather than silently omitting it
Output keeps the review report-only, posting nothing to the open PR absent an explicit opt-in
